issuer: the Dirección General de la Policía Estatal de Caminos of Tabasco
note: Read 2026-10-30 on the Congress of Tabasco's legislation pages. The Ley General de Tránsito y Vialidad del Estado de Tabasco (as last reformed 16 May 2026): licences are given for 2, 5 or 10 years (Art. 19); the automovilista's licence is for any private vehicle, and issuing licences and permits is the Dirección General de la Policía Estatal de Caminos's power (Art. 22); one may drive from eighteen in every class, with provisional permits from sixteen (Art. 24; the minors' permit of six months, Art. 26, isn't held). The Ley de Hacienda del Estado de Tabasco (as last reformed 11 April 2026), Art. 75, charges for issuing, renewing or replacing an automovilista's licence 7.0 UMA for two years, 16.0 for five and 30.0 for ten; the fee held is the two-year licence's, 7.0 UMA at INEGI's daily UMA for 2026 ($117.31), $821.17, worked out here (the law gives it in UMA; no rounding rule was read). Renewal is paid to the Secretaría de Administración y Finanzas (Art. 23). No identity card and no exchange list are held. The fee is held in UMA (the federal unit of account INEGI revalues each February), worth the UMA's value on the day it's paid; the peso figure worked here from INEGI's 2026 value is no figure the state publishes and isn't held (the lead, 2026-10-30).
